{{Top}}
[[File:Day_of_Three_Suns.png|thumb|right|330px|The [[Moorjhoni|inhabitants]] of [[Moorjhone]] are reduced to skeletons on the [[Day of Three Suns]].]]
{{Quote|Check it out! Skeletons!|[[Whie Malreaux/Legends|Whie Malreaux]] on [[Vjun/Legends|Vjun]]|<ref name="Yoda: Dark Rendezvous">''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]''</ref>}}
A '''skeleton''' was the [[Bone/Legends|bony]] structure that supported the body of many organisms in most [[Species/Legends|species]].

People with skeletons had weak points in their limb joints and skull, making these points more susceptible to injuries.<ref name="The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett">''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]''</ref>

Some people suffered from degenerative bone disorders, and could have their skeleton augmented with high-impact [[Polymer/Legends|polymer]]s. Because the skeletal reinforcements had to be integrated with the subject's tendons and ligaments, an oversight could result in chronic muscle fatigue as muscles overextended and pulled free of the reinforced bones.<ref name="Hero's Guide">''[[Hero's Guide]]''</ref>

There were many [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] and non-sentient species that did not have internal skeletons. Many species had [[exoskeleton]]s in place of an internal, bony framework, while other species possessed no internal or external body structure at all.
